title: RAW: simultaneous boundary-pair metathesis preserves interiors while word edges depend on their neighbor
summary: Complete invented hand transducer: choose distinct abstract units A,B and normalize only original A SPACE B to B SPACE A, once simultaneously. All word interiors, lengths, order and global unit counts remain. Reader returns every exact inverse candidate rather than guessing the intended source. A source-independent forbidden boundary applies between two nonsingleton words; singleton-generated exceptions are explicit.

design.mechanism: A scribe carries one final unit to the following initial position while writing the following initial unit first, only for one taught ordered pair. This is an invented boundary-writing convention, not an attested sound change, Arabic practice, corrected transcription or semantic claim.
design.source_domain: A document is a finite ordered list of nonempty words over22 abstract units. Empty documents are permitted. A andB are distinct units chosen once. One fixed bijection maps the22units to the22working signs. Source document and word boundaries are explicit and preserved; line wrapping is not a reset. No source language, actual phoneme inventory or word values selected.
writer: On the ORIGINAL source document, mark each boundary whose preceding word ends inA and following word begins inB.
Swap precisely those two boundary-adjacent units; retain the space between their positions. Apply the marked swaps simultaneously once, never to a newly created A|B. All other units stay fixed.

Marked swaps cannot share a unit: overlap would require a one-unit source word to be bothA andB. Thus A!=B makes the rule well-defined even on chains of singleton words. Apply the fixed output bijection last.
design.reader: Invert the output bijection. Enumerate subsets of its B|A boundaries, reverse each selected pair, then retain exactly those candidate source documents whose forward encoding equals the entire output. Reversed pairs also cannot share units. At most2^m candidates for m visible B|A boundaries; no hidden dictionary or preferred language selects a winner. AB andBA at a boundary genuinely collide.
design.state_cost: Two globally taught unit identities and one fixed22-unit table. The writer requires one-symbol lookahead across the next boundary, plus the pending final unit; no wordbook, lexical cache, counter or hidden reset. Reader candidate count can grow exponentially; systematic ambiguity is admitted, not labeled successful unique decoding.
examples: A | A | B -> A | B | A (shows that A|B is NOT globally absent)
design.necessary_consequence: Between two adjacent output groups each of length>=2, A|B cannot occur. Their respective last/first positions are affected only by their mutual boundary, so an original A|B is converted and no neighboring swap can create it. Singleton groups invalidate this shortcut and must remain in the full contract. One exact forbidden eligible boundary excludes that proposed(A,B)key; a surviving pair is merely capacity.
other_exact_invariants: Each source/output word has identical length. Every within-word position other than the first/last is unchanged before the bijection.
The full document unit multiset is unchanged. Per-word unit multisets need NOT be unchanged, unlike within-word permutation writers.

Repeated source words may have different edge spellings in different actual neighboring contexts, while their ordered interior remains identical. This supplies a defined contextual mechanism; no statistical fit or source-word identity is inferred from similar native forms.
design.smallest_decision_changing_check: Before any source decoder, inspect only an independently selected already-admitted complete adjacency packet for candidate ordered boundary pairs under both word-length premises. If every global(A,B)pair has a witnessed forbidden boundary, this exact family is excluded. Otherwise retain only capacity and require a separately fixed source/context comparison; do not count inverse coverage as a decipherment result. No packet, threshold, run or new native query selected here.
design.relation_to_positive_structure: A defined directed local operation generates reusable edge contrasts while retaining source word interiors and their lexical identity distribution. It can express context-dependent whole-form choice. This is a mechanism offered for review, not a demonstrated explanation of composition or whole-word predictive residuals.

known_limits: Purely phonetic interpretation is optional and unbound; this cannot identify metathesis in a real language.
Native working units may not be actual letters; true source words may not equal written groups. Those are explicit family premises, not resolved facts.
Optional application, more pair rules, multiple passes or hidden resets would change the registered rule and must not be installed after a failure.
The free source vocabulary is not a language explanation. A compatible boundary pair would not establish source plausibility, grammar or meaning.
